title: Resort Activity Waiver
scenario: A vendor sends a waiver link that also asks for card and passport details.

answers.A: Click/pay immediately to avoid losing the booking or offer.
answers.B: Check inside the official app, booking, provider, or government site.
answers.C: Forward it to a fellow traveller and ask what they think.
answers.D: Ignore/report the message and use a known contact route.

explanation: Resort Activity Waiver: the trap is to collect private data, images, or documents under pressure. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to click or follow the risky request.
proTip: Waivers should not collect unnecessary financial identity data.
